_what: Assignment pack for the process specification campaign. Everything you need about YOUR category. The full model.json is 148 KB and you do not need it; if you want a process id outside this category, ask.
_binding: _Collab/00_prompts/SPEC_CAMPAIGN_PROMPT.md is the binding instruction. _Collab/SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PACK.md is the only permitted source list. Read both in full before writing anything.

bands.Work Lifecycle: 1.0-5.0. Runs in sequence for a single piece of work.
bands.Specialised Operations: 6.0-11.0. Each runs the full lifecycle inside its own operational discipline.
bands.Foundations and Enabling: 12.0-16.0. Supplies assets, materials, workforce, information and external delivery capacity to every lifecycle stage rather than sitting inside the sequence.
bands.Asset Lifecycle: 17.0-19.0. The asset's own life - planned, created, operated and retired - as distinct from the work performed on it. Appended 2026-08-29 without renumbering anything: categories 1.0 to 16.0 keep their ids, uids and legacy_ids.

lifecycle_axis._why: The model is organised on a WORK axis - identify, plan, schedule, execute, close. APQC and GFMAM are organised on an ASSET axis - plan and acquire, design and construct, operate, maintain, dispose. The work axis is what happens inside 'maintain'. Both are valid; carrying both lets the model answer ISO 55001:2024 cl. 8.1 without abandoning the granularity that makes it a process model rather than a benchmarking taxonomy.
lifecycle_axis._all: 'all' marks an enabling category that serves every stage rather than sitting at one of them.

your_category.name: Manage Compliance, Integrity and Safety

processes.name: Perform asset patrol and mandated inspection
Perform pressure and pipeline integrity test
Record compliance evidence and completion dates
Read and record test station potentials
Generate and track corrosion remediation work
Classify leak by grade and severity
Schedule and perform locate and mark-out
Record locate evidence and positive response
Inspect pressure regulating and limiting stations
Monitor system pressure and abnormal operation

groups.name: Manage cross bores and subsurface conflicts

processes.name: Identify cross bore risk from trenchless installation
Inspect sewer laterals for cross bores
Maintain the written programme and system knowledge
Report the four mandatory integrity measures

your_category.summary: Meet regulatory obligations for asset integrity and public safety with auditable evidence.

apqc_rows_touching_your_category.note: Perform abandonment. 19.2.4 abandons in place as a lifecycle end state under 49 CFR 192.727. 8.6.6 Purge, seal and abandon facilities REMAINS in 8.6 as the gas pressure procedure; the two are hooked, not merged, because purging under 192.629 is a pressure operation and abandonment is a lifecycle transition.

Develop network operational plans. 19270 create switching and reconfiguration plans is closed at 18.1.2. The rest of the group - 19268 operation requirements, 19269 network demand analysis, 19271 simulate demand and network conditions - is real-time and forward planning, and 18.0 is scoped work-facing only by decision.

Perform planned network operation. Closed 2026-08-29 and the reason the Asset Lifecycle band exists. All seven APQC activities map: 19286 submit to 18.2.1, 19287 approve or reject to 18.2.2, 19288 schedule to 18.2.3, 19289 notify to 18.3, 19290 execute switching to 18.4.1, 19291 coordinate with maintenance and construction to 18.2.5, 19292 return to service to 18.5. 2.6.3 and 4.4.4 now name 18.4.4 as the producing process for the clearance.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Stakeholder Management
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Customer communication and pipeline public awareness only. No stakeholder management as a discipline, which is correct for a process reference.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Management Assurance and Audit
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Audit exists per programme - vegetation, DIMP, reporting obligations - but there is no assurance process over the asset management system itself.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Risk
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Asset risk and consequence of failure, and the distribution integrity programme.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Shutdown and Outage Strategy and Planning
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: GFMAM defines this as "An organisation's processes for the identification, planning, scheduling, execution, and control of work related to shutdowns, turnarounds, or outages (STOs)." All five verbs are now present: 18.1 identification and planning, 18.2 scheduling, 18.4 execution, 18.4.4 and 18.5 control. This subject and APQC 14.1.6 together are why the Asset Lifecycle band exists.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Operation
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: The work-facing half is closed at 18.0: planned switching, clearance, coordination and return to service. 9.0 covers unplanned operation. Real-time monitoring, alarm handling, optimisation and protection settings stay OUT OF SCOPE BY DECISION - they are SCADA, ADMS and DERMS functions.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Maintenance Delivery
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: This is the model's centre of gravity and it is the most complete subject in it.
